title: The network advantage: benefits of interregional scientific knowledge spillovers on AI patenting
abstract: arXiv:2609.26604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge spillovers have largely been studied as unintended externalities diffusing through geographic proximity, while deliberate interregional networks have been examined mostly through co-inventor ties rather than the scientific layer carried by co-authored publications. This study asks whether spillovers from interregional AI-related co-publications increase regional AI patenting, and whether the ownership composition of regional R&D shapes the capacity to capitalize on them. Using a network-econometric approach across 26 Chinese provincial-level regions from 2006 to 2020, we find that co-publication spillovers foster AI patenting, but the returns concentrate almost entirely in regions where privately owned enterprises dominate R&D, reinforcing regional divergence.

translated_title: 网络优势：区域间科学知识溢出对人工智能专利产出的益处
translated_abstract: 知识溢出在很大程度上被研究为通过地理邻近性扩散的非预期外部性，而有意构建的区域间网络则主要通过共同发明人关系来考察，而非通过合著论文所承载的科学层面。本研究探讨区域间人工智能相关合著论文产生的溢出效应是否会增加区域人工智能专利产出，以及区域研发的所有权构成是否会影响利用这些溢出效应的能力。我们采用网络计量经济学方法，对2006年至2020年间中国26个省级行政区进行分析，发现合著论文溢出效应促进了人工智能专利产出，但其收益几乎完全集中在民营企业主导研发的地区，从而加剧了区域分化。
tldr: 本研究利用网络计量经济学方法分析中国26个省级行政区2006-2020年的数据，发现区域间AI相关合著论文的知识溢出能促进AI专利产出，但其收益几乎完全集中于民营企业主导研发的地区，从而加剧区域分化。
en_tdlr: Using a network-econometric approach on 26 Chinese provincial regions (2006-2020), this study finds that interregional AI co-publication spillovers boost AI patenting, but the benefits accrue almost entirely to regions where privately owned enterprises dominate R&D, reinforcing regional divergence.
